prompt: Let customers stack coupons: calling apply_coupon() more than once should apply every coupon, not just the last one.

review.intent: Stacked coupons apply one after another, each to the price the earlier ones left (10% then 20% off $100 is $72), not added together (which would be $70). Adding percentages lets enough coupons reach 100% off.
review.correction: Don't add the percentages together. Apply each coupon in turn to what's left after the earlier ones, so 10% and then 20% off $100 comes to $72, not $70.
